name: Moero of Byzantium
bio: Moero of Byzantium is one of the epigrammatists whose short poems were gathered in the Greek Anthology. Paton's index of authors dates the poet to c. 300 BC. Paton's index lists the poet among the writers of Meleager's Wreath, the Garland compiled about 100 BC.
This archive carries the 2 epigrams ascribed to the poet in the first volume of W. R. Paton's prose translation (Books I–VI) (Book VI: 119, 189).

poems.title: Book VI, 119
poems.author: Moero of Byzantium
poems.text: Cluster, full of the juice of Dionysus, thou restest under the roof of Aphrodite’s golden chamber : no longer shall the vine, thy mother, cast her lovely branch around thee, and put forth above thy head her sweet leaves,

poems.title: Book VI, 189
poems.author: Moero of Byzantium
poems.text: Ye Anigrian nymphs, daughters of the stream, ambrosial beings that ever tread these depths with your rosy feet, all hail, and cure Cleonymus, who set up for you under the pines these fair images.

poems.title: To the Nymphs of Anigrus (Mackail)
poems.author: Moero of Byzantium
poems.collection: Select Epigrams from the Greek Anthology (1890)
poems.text: Nymphs of Anigrus, maidens of the river, who evermore tread with rosy feet these divine depths, hail and save Cleonymus who set these fair images to you, goddesses, beneath the pines.

poems.title: To Aphrodite of the Golden House (Mackail)
poems.author: Moero of Byzantium
poems.collection: Select Epigrams from the Greek Anthology (1890)
poems.text: Thou liest in the golden portico of Aphrodite, O grape-cluster filled full of Dionysus' juice, nor ever more shall thy mother twine round thee her lovely tendril or above thine head put forth her honeyed leaf.

poems.title: Anthologia Graeca VI.119: κεῖσαι δὴ χρυσέαν ὑπὸ παστάδα τὰν Ἀφροδίτας,
poems.author: Moero of Byzantium
poems.text:
κεῖσαι δὴ χρυσέαν ὑπὸ παστάδα τὰν Ἀφροδίτας,
βότρυ, Διωνύσου πληθόμενος σταγόνι·
οὐδʼ ἔτι τοι μάτηρ ἐρατὸν περὶ κλῆμα βαλοῦσα
φύσει ὑπὲρ κρατὸς νεκτάρεον πέταλον·

poems.title: Anthologia Graeca VI.189: νύμφαι Ἀνιγριάδες, ποταμοῦ κόραι, αἳ τάδε βένθη
poems.author: Moero of Byzantium
poems.text:
νύμφαι Ἀνιγριάδες, ποταμοῦ κόραι, αἳ τάδε βένθη
ἀμβρόσιαι ῥοδέοις στείβετε ποσσὶν ἀεί,
χαίρετε καὶ σῴζοιτε Κλεώνυμον, ὃς τάδε καλὰ
εἵσαθʼ ὑπαὶ πιτύων ὔμμι, θεαί, ξόανα.
